description: This file contains unit tests for LocationHandler class in the Android application, specifically testing location permission handling, permission checks, and location fetch behaviors using a fake data source.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying behavior of LocationHandler in various permission and location fetching scenarios.

classes.name: FakeLocationDataSource
classes.description: Mock implementation of LocationDataSource used for testing LocationHandler behavior without real location services.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Tests that location retrieval requires permissions if neither fine nor coarse permission is granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Tests that foreground access is required before location permission can be granted.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Checks that the permission status reflects the data source state for fine and coarse permissions.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that precise GPS providers are used first when fine permission is granted and precise mode is enabled.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures fallback to balanced accuracy providers when precise providers are unavailable.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Tests that a timeout in location fetch maps to a LOCATION_TIMEOUT error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Tests that other failures in location fetch map to LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE error.
